description: Auto-approve tugplug skills and safe Bash commands; deny file-lifecycle commands the change ledger cannot read, and any repo write an arc stage makes after closing a step in the same turn; refuse a known or declared test runner on a line a here-document, a `$(…)` or a backtick makes unreadable, since it would run dark; give every readable Bash call its id (`export TUG_TOOL_USE_ID=<id>; `) so whatever it runs reports to its block, and rewrite a known or declared test runner (`tugtool report runners` lists them) — bare, or inside a `tugtool file probe` — to run inside `tugtool test run` so its block gets the report panel. Decided by `tugtool hook pre-tool-use`.
